title: salsola kali subsp. gmelinii
intro: Salsola kali subsp. gmelinii, commonly known as Prickly Saltwort, is a succulent halophyte plant that is native to the arid regions of Eastern Europe and Central Asia. Prickly Saltwort has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its antimicrobial and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Prickly Saltwort include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit anti-inflammatory and antiseptic activities, and show potential in treating various skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Prickly Saltwort include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
